_comment: Consolidated Sa'i trips. Replaces trip1_details.json through trip7_details.json. Parser resolves {trip} and {direction} at load time. Each trip expands into 4 cards (5 for trip 7).

begin_safa._comment: Used for trips 1, 3, 5, 7 — starting at Safa
begin_safa.description: Climb the steps of Safa, face the direction of the Kaabah, raise your hands and recite the niyyah dua. Begin with what Allah began with.

begin_marwa._comment: Used for trips 2, 4, 6 — starting at Marwa
begin_marwa.description: Climb the steps of Marwa, face the direction of the Kaabah, raise your hands and make dua before walking back toward Safa.

green_area._comment: Shared for all 7 trips — jog through the green-lit Masa'a section
green_area.description: Men: increase your pace (harwala) through the green-lit section of the Masa'a. Women continue at a normal walking pace. Recite: Rabbi-ghfir warḥam wa'fu wa takarram wa tajāwaz 'ammā ta'lam.

later_saei._comment: Shared for all 7 trips — after the green zone, continue to the destination hill
later_saei.description: After passing the green zone, resume normal pace and continue toward the destination. Recite: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā hasanatan wa fil-ākhirati hasanatan wa qinā 'adhāban-nār.

end_saei.description: You have completed 7 trips of Sa'i. At Marwa, face the Kaabah, raise your hands and make the acceptance dua. Your Sa'i is now complete.

dua.description: Innash-Shafā wal-Marwata min sha'ā'irillāh. Abda'u bimā bada'allāhu bih. (Verily, Safa and Marwah are among the signs of Allah. I begin with that which Allah began with.)
Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, wa lillāhil-hamd. (Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and for Allah is all praise.)
Rabbighfir warham wa tajawaz 'amma ta'lam innaka antal-a'azzul-akram. (My Lord, forgive and have mercy and overlook that which You know, for You are the Most Mighty, the Most Noble.)

La ilaha ill-Allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. (There is no god but Allah alone, no partner has He, to Him belongs the dominion and to Him the praise.)
Allahumma inni as'aluka al-'afwa wal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. (O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.)
Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar. (Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.)
Allahumma taqabbal minna sa'yana kama taqabbalta min nabiyyika Ibrahim alayhis-salam. (O Allah, accept our Sa'i as You accepted from Your Prophet Ibrahim, peace be upon him.)
